channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Meta faces ‘astronomical’ consequences as legal fight reaches critical moment in California
item.description: Meta faces a federal trial over child safety claims that could bring major financial penalties and changes to Facebook and Instagram.

item.title: Nvidia backing $105 billion in financing for OpenAI data center in Ohio
item.description: Technology giants are shelling out billions to scale capacity to meet massive data center demand.

item.title: Trump threatens to 'bomb' Oman if it 'gets in the way' as U.S.-Iran ceasefire expires
item.description: Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz sank to a new low as a ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is set to expire on Monday with no deal in sight.

item.title: Nvidia financing initiative follows SEC guidance that takes sponsors off the hook for data center investments
item.description: Recent SEC instructions on data center bonds appear applicable to the recent Nvidia financing move, lawyers say.

item.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump bid to overturn E. Jean Carroll verdict
item.description: President Trump was held civilly liable in the case by a New York federal jury for defaming and sexually abusing the writer E. Jean Carroll.

item.title: Synchrony, credit card issuer to Amazon and Walmart, partners with OpenAI for ChatGPT shopping
item.description: Maran Nalluswami, Synchrony's chief strategy officer, told CNBC it will probably take six to 12 months to get payments fully integrated into ChatGPT.

item.title: 'Don't get too comfortable': Wall Street’s ‘fear gauge’ hits 2026 low — here's why it's unlikely to last
item.description: A falling VIX points to growing investor complacency ahead of a traditionally turbulent time for markets, strategists warn.

item.title: Oil prices rise as Iran rules out interim deal extension, threatens to escalate conflict
item.description: The U.S.-Iran deal was supposed to open the Strait of Hormuz while they negotiated a final deal on Tehran's nuclear program within 60 days.

item.title: What the results of a Connecticut congressional primary race may mean for Social Security
item.description: Rep. John Larson of Connecticut, an advocate for expanding Social Security, was ousted in a Democratic primary contest Tuesday.

item.title: College can cost $100,000 a year. Here's how families are covering the tab
item.description: Because families struggle to pay for school, many students and their parents increasingly depend on federal and private aid to help foot the bill.

item.title: OpenAI's Brockman brushes off concerns about leadership changes in CNBC exclusive
item.description: Brockman told CNBC he doesn't think the wave of recent departures at OpenAI are 'actually that atypical.'

item.title: What will TV look like in three years? Media insiders share their predictions
item.description: CNBC asked media insiders what they think the TV market — from pay TV subscribers to sports ratings — will look like in three years.

item.title: Santoli: Earnings bonanza that lifted market to record may not be all that it appears to be
item.description: The S&P 500 is up more than 6% in 12 trading days to record levels.

item.title: Vista Energy up 4% after billionaire Peter Thiel buys stake in the Argentine shale oil producer
item.description: Peter Thiel’s hedge fund disclosed a $76 million stake in Argentine oil producer Vista Energy, sending its shares higher in premarket trading.

item.title: Russia targets Danube port after one of Ukraine’s largest aerial attacks of the war
item.description: Russia struck port infrastructure in Ukraine’s Odesa region, damaging a Togo-flagged civilian vessel near Izmail after Kyiv launched a major drone attack on Moscow.

item.title: Ferrari Luce: Polarizing EV becomes a $40 million collector’s item
item.description: The auction of the Luce comes nearly three months after Ferrari unveiled its first fully electric car, which was priced at 550,000 euros (roughly $640,000).

item.title: Between earn-nothing cash, broken long-term bonds, these are the safety trades of 2026 market
item.description: Investors have flocked to short-term investments like ultra-short bond funds in anticipation of a stock market correction and with long-term bonds broken.

item.title: I drove Tesla FSD, Rivian Autonomy+ ‘hands-free’ driving systems. Here’s how they compare
item.description: Rivian is trying to catch up to Tesla's "hands-free" capabilities, but with additional safety guardrails that the Elon Musk company doesn't have.

item.title: AOC says she's been saving up to freeze her eggs. Here's how much the procedure can cost
item.description: AOC is highlighting the cost of freezing her eggs. Here's what to know about health insurance coverage, state laws and taxes associated with the process.

item.title: Lamborghini unveils Revuelto SV, its most powerful production car ever
item.description: Lamborghini's Revuelto SV is a limited-edition V12 hybrid with over 1,050 horsepower, a 2.4-second 0-to-100 kph time and a $741,172 starting price.

item.title: Depleted strategic oil reserve nears level that raises concerns about damage to caverns, operations
item.description: The rapid drawdown of the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve could damage the caverns that store the oil, experts warn.

item.title: Marijuana reform is emerging as a midterm elections issue on both sides of the aisle
item.description: With November's midterms fast approaching, cannabis reform is an issue. It's popular with voters, but its power to tilt elections remains uncertain.

item.title: China's economy slows further in July as retail sales barely grow, investment slump steepens
item.description: The data is reinforcing concerns about the health of the world's second-largest economy, which has grappled with a deepening supply-demand imbalance.

item.title: Extreme heat spurs earliest-ever Champagne harvest, putting its famous taste to the test
item.description: Producers of the iconic French fizz face a challenge to preserve its taste profile while they also battle tariff complications and fewer drinkers.

item.title: Secret outperformer: Dispelling the 'myths' about an unloved stock market
item.description: European markets fly under the radar when compared with larger and more liquid U.S. markets, but Goldman Sachs offered to dispel some of the myths.

item.title: Prediction markets and sports betting: How this UK exchange is trying to do both in the U.S.
item.description: Smarkets is entering the U.S. prediction market race but also applying to run as a sportsbook within states amid regulatory uncertainty at the federal level.

item.title: Anthropic revenue reportedly jumps to more than $11.5 billion in second quarter
item.description: The jump in revenue underscores the rapid growth of the Claude chatbot maker as it prepares for a potential blockbuster initial public offering.

item.title: Japan second-quarter GDP grows 1.1% on an annualized basis, missing expectations
item.description: On an annualized basis, Japan saw growth of 1.1%, against estimates of 2%.

item.title: Nvidia discloses $21 billion stake in SpaceX at end of second quarter
item.description: Nvidia's stake in SpaceX, which came through an investment in xAI, was worth about $21 billion at the end of the second quarter.

item.title: The internet's grandma has advice for late bloomers: 'It doesn't all have to be perfect'
item.description: Kim Murstein and Gail Rudnick are the duo behind "Excuse My Grandma," an advice podcast that dives into life, love and other issues across generations.
